summary: Shell script implementation is secure and correct. No command injection, path traversal, or exploitable vulnerabilities found. Term sanitization via ^[a-z0-9]+$ regex filters is well-designed, preventing regex injection in grep patterns. Variables are consistently double-quoted. Error handling with || true is correctly placed for grep no-match cases. set -euo pipefail provides a solid safety net. Two minor observations (not blocking): (1) $exclude_pattern in find_related_docs() line 134 passes git file paths unsanitized into grep -E, which could cause incorrect doc inclusion if filenames contain regex metacharacters — impact is limited to prompt content, not exploitable; (2) diff_stats, new_files, related_docs are not declared local in build_prompt() — style issue only. Dockerfile change (extra apt-get update before PPA) and STRUCTURE.md updates are straightforward infrastructure/docs changes with no security implications.
